projects.title: Aadhya Self Drive — Flutter iOS & Android
implementation: Flutter app for iOS and Android with location-based search, flexible rental durations, and end-to-end trip management
Booking flow with document upload, renter verification steps, and payment integration tied to the rental backend
TestFlight and Google Play release pipeline including store listings, screenshots, and versioned rollout updates
Push notifications for booking confirmations, trip reminders, and status changes
Performance tuning for offline-tolerant flows, deep links from marketing pages, and analytics on conversion steps
projects.brief: Ship a cross-platform mobile app for Aadhya Self Drive so renters browse vehicles, complete verification, book trips, and pay on iOS and Android from one Flutter codebase, with App Store and Play Store release.

projects.title: CabinetSense — SaaS platform & RAG assistant
implementation: Refactored the legacy support board from JSP to lazy JSON APIs with batch Google Cloud Datastore loads, cutting page load time and enabling real-time ticket updates
Built a FastAPI RAG service on Cloud Run with Pinecone retrieval, Cohere rerank, MMR diversity, and multi-LLM routing so answers stay grounded in product docs
Integrated JWT authentication, FastSpring licensing, and usage metering so AI features bill correctly per customer tier
Shipped nightly BigQuery exports for AI usage, feedback scores, and support metrics so product and ops can track adoption
Connected SketchUp extension workflows so designers query documentation and support context without leaving the design tool
projects.brief: Modernize Millcreek support operations with a Kanban and list ticketing board, embed an AI assistant inside SketchUp for cabinet designers, and deploy production RAG over CabinetSense product documentation with usage-based billing and nightly analytics export.

projects.title: RAG knowledge base — internal docs search
implementation: Offline ingestion pipeline: parse PDFs and HTML, chunk with metadata (title, section, URL), embed with OpenAI, upsert into Pinecone
FastAPI search service: embed questions, retrieve top-k chunks, rerank for relevance, and generate answers with inline source citations
Admin endpoints to trigger full or incremental re-index, compare retrieval scores on test questions, and monitor index freshness
Authentication on search APIs, rate limits per team, and logging of queries for quality review
Evaluation harness with golden questions so search quality is measured after every documentation update
projects.brief: Deliver an internal RAG search system for Komal HK over B2B SaaS documentation — natural-language queries, semantic retrieval from wikis and PDFs, cited answers, and re-indexing when content changes.

projects.title: Internal copilot — LLM with tools
implementation: RAG retrieval layer over Confluence and Notion with chunking, metadata filters, and citation links in every answer
Function-calling orchestration with tool adapters for Jira (create/update tickets) and Slack (post summaries) using scoped OAuth credentials
Role-based access controls so users only retrieve docs and run actions they are permitted to perform
Prompt guardrails, PII redaction in logs, and request audit trails for security and compliance review
FastAPI service with streaming responses, conversation history, and admin dashboard for prompt and tool configuration
projects.brief: Build an internal copilot for Finer Technologies that answers from Confluence and Notion, runs approved Jira and Slack actions on behalf of users, and enforces role-based access with full audit logging for compliance.

projects.title: AI Invoice Bot — OCR + LLM extraction
implementation: Tesseract and Google Cloud Vision preprocessing pipeline for skew correction, denoising, and text region detection on photographed invoices
LLM structured extraction with JSON schema validation, confidence scoring, and human-review flags for low-quality scans
FastAPI endpoints for batch upload, async processing queues, and structured error responses when OCR or parsing fails
Dockerized workers with retry logic, dead-letter handling for malformed files, and reconciliation reports for finance teams
Integration hooks so extracted fields map cleanly into downstream accounting and ERP import formats
projects.brief: Eliminate manual invoice entry from photos and PDFs for M2i Consulting by building an OCR plus LLM extraction pipeline that validates party names, line items, and totals before data reaches accounting workflows.

projects.title: LLM training pipeline — code review
implementation: Full audit of training code: batching strategy, gradient accumulation, memory usage, and distributed training configuration
Checkpoint strategy with versioned model artifacts, automatic resume from last good state, and S3-compatible storage layout
Docker image hardening: multi-stage builds, pinned dependencies, GPU runtime flags, and health checks for orchestrators
Runbooks for retraining schedules, hyperparameter sweeps, rollback procedures, and on-call escalation paths
Recommendations for CI validation, dataset versioning with Git, and monitoring training loss and GPU utilization
projects.brief: Review and harden SME Careers' Python and Docker LLM training pipeline — improve data loading, checkpointing, failure recovery, and operational runbooks so containerized training jobs are production-ready.

projects.title: GCP Dataflow — Confluent to BigQuery
implementation: Apache Beam pipeline on GCP Dataflow with autoscaling workers and configurable parallelism per topic
Confluent schema registry integration with Avro/JSON deserialization and explicit handling of schema evolution
Dead-letter topic and BigQuery error tables so poison messages never block the main stream
Cloud Monitoring dashboards and alerting on consumer lag, DLQ volume, and pipeline failure rates
Documented deployment, backfill procedures, and cost tuning guidance for ops handover
projects.brief: Stream Confluent Kafka events into BigQuery for CrossroadsCX in near real time, with schema validation, dead-letter handling for bad records, and dashboards for throughput, lag, and error rates.

projects.title: Hadoop-to-GCP migration
implementation: Inventory of Hive, MapReduce, and Spark jobs with dependency mapping and risk-ranked migration plan
Rewrote pipelines for Dataproc and BigQuery with phased cutover and parallel validation against legacy outputs
Airflow orchestration for migrated jobs with SLA monitoring and rollback paths during transition
Documentation for operations: cluster sizing, cost controls, and runbooks for on-call engineers
Sign-off criteria with row-count and aggregate reconciliation reports for each migrated pipeline
projects.brief: Migrate SaiKumar's on-prem Hadoop batch and streaming workloads to GCP without breaking lineage validation or daily reporting — reduce ops cost and unblock cloud-native analytics.

projects.title: ML feature pipeline — training & serving
implementation: Feature store patterns with Airflow DAGs for daily feature computation and backfill on schema changes
MLflow integration for experiment tracking, model registry, and promotion gates before production deploy
REST serving layer on Kubernetes with autoscaling, latency monitoring, and one-click rollback to prior model versions
Data validation steps between stages so bad upstream data does not poison training or serving
Documentation and handover for the client team to operate retraining and releases independently
projects.brief: Build a single orchestrated path for Diana Fernandez from raw data through feature engineering, model training, registry promotion, and a production serving API — ending manual per-run feature rebuilds.

projects.title: Data governance & quality platform
implementation: Enterprise Data Insight and Data Quality platform for steward workflows, issue tracking, and remediation status
Scalable analytics on Spark and Spark-SQL with Scala for profiling millions of rows across analytical datasets
Automated checks: null rates, distribution shifts, correlation anomalies, and cross-table consistency rules
Contributed to data modeling and architecture sessions, improving pipeline design and ownership boundaries
Dashboards for stewards showing trend lines, open issues, and SLA compliance per domain
projects.brief: Give KPMG data stewards automated profiling, null and correlation checks, and governance workflows at scale — surface quality issues before downstream reports fail.

projects.title: Clinical ETL — Crunch & Hadoop
implementation: End-to-end ETL pipelines with Apache Crunch and Hadoop MapReduce for high-volume clinical ingest
Frameworks for cleansing, transforming, and normalizing heterogeneous clinical datasets before analytics consumption
REST services with Beadledom (RESTEasy) exposing processed entities with pagination, filtering, and auth
Data quality checks at ingest with quarantine paths for records that fail validation rules
Hive tables and documentation so analytics teams understand lineage from raw feed to served API
projects.brief: Build consistent clinical ETL for Cerner — cleanse and normalize messy inbound feeds in HDFS and expose governed REST access so downstream apps stop working from inconsistent raw copies.

projects.title: Portfolio accounting — cache & reconciliation
implementation: Distributed caching layer with Hazelcast tuned for portfolio calculation hot paths and near-linear scale-out
Reconciliation frameworks comparing cache entries to authoritative database snapshots on a scheduled and on-demand basis
AppDynamics agents and custom metrics for cache hit rates, eviction patterns, and calculation latency under trading load
Spring services refactored for cache-aside patterns with clear fallback when nodes fail or partitions occur
Production support playbooks for market-open incidents, cache warm-up, and emergency bypass to direct DB reads
projects.brief: Improve portfolio read performance and cache consistency for Accolite's Morgan Stanley engagement — reduce latency during market hours and reconciliation risk between cache and authoritative database records.

projects.title: Investment bank desktop clients
implementation: Rich Eclipse RCP clients using SWT and JFace for complex trading and operations UI with responsive layouts
JAXB XML marshalling and unmarshalling with validation, error recovery, and logging for backend message exchange
Requirement analysis, estimation, and iterative delivery aligned with bank release calendars and change control
Linux deployment targets with packaging, installer scripts, and environment-specific configuration profiles
Production support rotation: incident triage, log analysis, and patch releases for critical desk workflows
projects.brief: Deliver Eclipse RCP desktop clients for HCLTech's global investment bank client — trading and operations workflows with reliable JAXB XML messaging to backend services and ongoing production support.

projects.title: REST API — partner integrations
implementation: Spring Boot REST API with OpenAPI 3 specification, interactive Swagger docs, and OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flows for partner apps
Per-client rate limits, idempotency keys on write endpoints, and structured JSON error codes with actionable messages
PostgreSQL-backed token store, request audit logging, and role scopes so partners access only permitted resources
Sample SDK snippets, sandbox credentials, and step-by-step partner onboarding runbooks
Docker images and deployment configs for staging and production with health checks and rolling updates
projects.brief: Expose a partner-facing REST API for AppLand Inc with OpenAPI documentation, OAuth authentication, rate limiting, consistent error responses, and SDK examples so external integrators can onboard without engineering support.

projects.title: Full-stack dashboard — pipeline health
implementation: Flask backend aggregating Airflow run metadata, task durations, and data quality check results into a unified API
React and TypeScript frontend with Tailwind: status cards, filters by pipeline and date, and drill-down detail panels
Alert hooks integrated with existing Slack and email notification channels when SLAs breach or checks fail
Role-based views so ops sees all pipelines while team leads see their owned workflows
Deployed on GCP with authenticated access and documented refresh intervals for each data source
projects.brief: Give Polina H. one dashboard for pipeline health instead of checking Airflow, logs, and email separately — SLA status, run history, and quality-check alerts in a single view.

projects.title: ELK stack — log search & alerts
implementation: Logstash pipelines with per-service parsing rules, grok patterns, and field normalization for consistent search
Elasticsearch cluster sizing, index lifecycle templates, and hot-warm tiering for cost-effective retention
Kibana dashboards for error rates, latency trends, and top failing endpoints by service
Watcher-style alerts to Slack when thresholds breach, with runbook links in alert payloads
Docker-based deployment on AWS with backup snapshots and documented restore procedures
projects.brief: Centralize logs for ash n's distributed services — replace SSH and grep with searchable Elasticsearch, retention policies, Kibana dashboards, and alerts when error rates spike.
